description: FOQUS is the U.S. Carbon Capture Simulation Initiative's platform for process optimisation, uncertainty analysis and surrogate models. It contains a graphical flowsheet editor, connections to process simulators and tools for experiment design. Inputs are linked process models, variables and uncertainty assumptions; outputs support comparison of plant configurations and operating choices. Coverage is the specified industrial process, while time representation depends on its connected models. Python source is free under the repository's BSD-style licence, which includes an additional grant for voluntarily supplied enhancements. A limitation is that Turbine Gateway is required and optional functions depend on separately licensed products such as GAMS or ALAMO. FOQUS supports carbon-capture and industrial energy-system simulations. MOOSE (platform-moose-multiphysics-framework) is a related engineering simulation environment, without a verified direct interface. The own documentation explains how simulations are queued and coupled; no external simulator or gateway was accessed.
